FEAT-3-S98.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Validation
FEAT-3-S98.description: Implement and enforce Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location) and outputs (trial metadata, locations, distance, duration) to ensure strict contract validation across layers.

FEAT-3-S99.title: EvaluateCare Facade Integration for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S99.description: Integrate clinical_trials_service into evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate search requests, invoke distance calculations, and return normalized results to the application layer.

FEAT-3-S100.title: Clinical Trials Search API Exposure via Tool Router
FEAT-3-S100.description: Expose clinical trials search capability through the tool_router with proper allowlisting, input validation, and structured response handling for LLM tool-use.

FEAT-3-S101.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Service
FEAT-3-S101.description: Develop unit tests for clinical_trials_service logic and integration tests covering facade and tool_router execution paths, including API mocking for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes.
